effects.effect: You gain a [surge](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.resource/surge) the first time in a [round](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/combat-round) that your demon [minions](scc.v1:mcdm.summoner.v1/feature.summoner.level-1/minions) deal 3 or more [damage](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.damage/damage) to a creature while you have [line of effect](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/line-of-effect) to the boil. You can choose to give the [surge](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.resource/surge) to an ally who also has [line of effect](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/line-of-effect) to the boil.
